page.layout: One block of text in a single column, with no marginal notes and no printed page number. The running head is at the top, and the last word of the paragraph is completed in the right-hand position at the foot.

p.i: possint & magno cum successu in locis peregrinis instaurare, interim tamen hic in otio inutili malunt considere, quam alibi Sacro Sancto Ministerio defungi, ubi segetem amplissimam sibi vident à Deo paratam, se coram ipso esse inexcusabiles proprio cordis sui testimonio convincuntur? Mente longè præstantiore ac zelo majore fratrem tuum præditum esse, ex seriâ ejus admonitione concludo, ex quâ ejus animum ad munus quod alijs præscribit non parum propendere animad-verto. Quo nomine ipsi gratu-lor, ac Deum precor ut Sanctis ipsius conatibus ad Nominis sui gloriam atque Ecclesiæ suæ incrementum, abundè è cœlo benedi-cat.

page.notes: The text is set in italic type throughout, apart from the decorative initial letters "M" of "Mente" and "Q" of "Quo". The printed "&" before "magno" has been kept as printed. The final word "cat." stands at the right, after the hyphen of "benedi-", so it is taken as the completion of the broken word and not as a catchword.
